O'Donell 提出治理方案，让 linux man-pages 逐步成为权威文档：项目手册定位为任务导向文档，而 linux man-pages 作为所有源自 ISO C、POSIX、BSD 及其他系统、并据此派生且按底层内核适当偏离的 API 的权威参考；建立 Authoritative for glibc / musl / uclibc 一类的标记与含超时约定的评审流程，推动 glibc 手册删除 API 引用只留任务导向内容，以减少各实现对派生 API 的重复文档工作。

Al Viro 在回复 Felker 关于 close 语义分歧的来信时提出自己的论断, 认为问题与其说是分歧不如说是 POSIX 内部决策流程的崩溃, 原话为 It's not so much disagreement as breakage of internal POSIX decision process that has lead to POSIX irrelevance in this particular area. POSIX authority derives from the agreement of actual behaviour of Unices. ... What they can't do is to force such change by fiat. Especially not when Linux and *BSD happen to agree on behaviour that differs from what they wish it to be. Al Viro 在此封中引 Felker 原话仅为其已记不清分歧所在, 上述权威论断系 Viro 本封自述。

Jiri Slaby 在 ath5k GPLv2 许可补丁讨论中提出："This mess has been occurring in the kernel for years. The DRM graphics drivers are used in both BSD and Linux. It is quite easy to contribute something to this code via LKML and think you are doing it under the GPL. Doesn't a patch against the kernel have to be GPL? When these patches get pulled back into BSD and distributed with it, did BSD get infected with the GPL? AFAIK this has never been legally sorted out."——即 BSD/GPL 双许可下的法律感染问题在内核中长期存在。Alan Cox 反驳：“I'm not aware anyone has felt it needed "sorting out". Its not exactly complicated. BSD non advertising is compatible with GPL The GPL says: "when you distribute the same sections as part of a whole which is a work based on the Program, the distribution of the whole must be on the terms of this License, " The BSD license doesn't conflict with that… All a bit irrelevant anyway as Ath5K code (not the .h file) say: * Alternatively, this software may be distributed under the terms of the GNU General Public License ("GPL") version 2 as published by the Free Software Foundation. So Jiri is choosing to distribute it under the GPL, and with his changes GPL only. So whats the problem ?”——即 BSD 非广告条款与 GPL 兼容，且 ath5k 代码本身已明文允许 GPL v2。此为 BSD/GPL 双许可治理难题在内核中的集中记录。

NeilBrown Magna Carta 纲领：现行文档 upside down——此类文档意义在限制强者（引 Dave 的 power 框架）；普通参与者几乎无权力（lkml 噪声洪流/bugzilla 鬼城）、唯一力量=贡献价值×被倾听；Linus 拥有全部权力——patches 是通货；维护者从信任线获权再传递（noblesse oblige）；范本该是 Magna Carta——“我们不需要维护者告诉参与者如何行为、可能需要维护者告诉 Linus 如何行为”；盼 Linus 自颁、否则社区起草、他可修改——这是他对社区关于使用权力的声明；并行需要替代补丁通道（“无法共事时 Linus/Andrew 直接考虑、须指明尝试过何处为何失败”）；“伤害不在虐待而在无力感”（petition to caesar 比喻）；若 Linus 不守住新敏感可设 Greg 共同维护者通道；三条件：限制强者/自愿采纳/替代补丁流。

以上为邮件列表当事人一手自述/主张，属过程性证据，具体技术结论仍须以源码与提交记录复核为准，不得单独引为定论。

2023年5月 coredump/vmcore 修复“coredump, vmcore: Set p_align to 4 for PT_NOTE”被合入 for-next/execve（提交 60592fb6b67c）。本封作者 Kees Cook 的正文只是一次合入确认：“Applied to for-next/execve, thanks!”加提交链接与署名，本身不含任何 BSD 内容。BSD 相关性完全来自被回复者 Fangrui Song 的补丁描述，其中说明了改动理由并引出 FreeBSD：readelf 与 llvm-readelf 依据 p_align 把 PT_NOTE 程序头解析为 4 字节条目数组或 8 字节条目数组，目前 Linux 上有变通做法把 p_align==0 当作 4 处理；更合适的做法是给出正确的对齐值，让工具不必依赖猜测，而 FreeBSD 的 coredump 同样把 p_align 设为 4（原话“FreeBSD coredumps set p_align to 4 as well.”）。需注意 FreeBSD 在此处的作用是为“p_align 取 4 是正确值”提供并列佐证，说明各实现做法一致，而非被 Linux 追随的布局模型。
